description: The structured result any worker returns (Section 3: workers are proposers). A worker never writes state directly; its result becomes a Proposal the commit gate validates. The result carries who produced it, under which lease, what evidence class supports it, and content addresses of everything it produced -- speculative outputs stay separate from verified dependencies via the evidence kind.
title: WorkerResult

base_revision.description: Journal revision this result was produced against.

evidence_kind.description: Mirrors commit_gate.vocab.EvidenceKind (11.5): heuristic evidence can never back a verified conclusion.

verdict.description: Critic results (12.4): the reviewer's conclusion on the leased claim. Mirrors the favorable/unfavorable Attempt statuses.

counterexample_artifact.description: Critic results: content address of a counterexample witness, when the verdict refutes.

parent_state_id.description: Explorer results (12.4): the research state a proposed move hangs from.

move_detail.description: Explorer results: what the proposed research move is and why.
